admission.justification: A stale success receipt after a failed child makes a cut install look complete; the four parameter cases and removed-fix controls exercise the exact paths.

applicability: Every public sandbox install attempt and its receipt history.
conditions: The prior current receipt is retired into history before the child runs.
Cut, timeout and malformed outcomes record the underlying error with real receipt and server-log paths instead of exposing an old success.
exclusions: The product's own result envelope keeps its own obligation.

evidence: notes/reports/role-launch/260928-MIK-L96-reviewer-e0a83546-a27f-4486-bb70-c11b906053fb.evidence/fix-verification-round-4/focused.log: exact receipt-payload and four cut/timeout/malformed parameter cases pass, current receipt absent at both child admissions, old success retained in history, current failure/log/serverLog/receipt fields checked; failed-start adapter preserves original install error and points to host-install-server.log; Operations.runtime_install validates payload type and nonzero success-body contradictions.

statement: Each public install retires the prior current receipt into history before its child runs and records fresh cut/timeout/malformed failures with underlying error and real receipt/server-log paths instead of exposing old success.
